user.title: Create an encode-first Stremio library
user.description: Configure the PC Stream Server and providers. Every selected source is sent through forced HLS transcoding before playback.

data_description.catalog_manifest_urls: One URL per line. Cinemeta is preloaded.
data_description.stream_manifest_urls: One URL per line. Torrentio is preloaded.
data_description.subtitle_manifest_urls: OpenSubtitles v3 is preloaded; leave empty to disable.
data_description.latin_manifest_urls: Preloaded to prioritize Spanish/Latin audio. This profile plays without subtitles.
data_description.sports_manifest_urls: StremVerse is preloaded for F1 and sports. Its outages do not block movies and series.
data_description.default_media_player: Original Chromecast or another media_player entity

data.play_ideal_on_select: Play ideal link when selecting an item
data.max_size_gb: Maximum source size in GB (0 = unlimited)
data.cast_reset_before_play: Fully close Cast receiver before playback
data.playback_start_timeout: Seconds allowed for each encoded source to start
data.failure_notify_ha: Notify in Home Assistant after all sources fail

data_description.stream_manifest_urls: Default providers for movies and series.
data_description.latin_manifest_urls: Preloaded with a Spanish/Latin provider. Used only by Latin Audio and plays without subtitles.
data_description.sports_manifest_urls: StremVerse is preloaded for F1/sports. A temporary failure does not block the rest of the integration.
data_description.subtitle_manifest_urls: One URL per line. Leave empty to disable.
data_description.play_ideal_on_select: Movies, episodes and events start without opening the source list.
data_description.ideal_link_filter: Ranks by preferred resolution, seed count and source size. Codec and container names are not used.
data_description.audio_mode: Fixed to force_transcode. Direct and automatic playback are disabled in this variant.
data_description.preferred_quality: Choosing 1080p or lower reduces the work required to produce the Chromecast Gen 1 output.
data_description.exclude_keywords: Comma separated, for example CAM, TS, HDCAM.
data_description.subtitle_mode: Automatic loads the first preferred language on Google Cast.
data_description.subtitle_languages: ISO codes in priority order, for example spa, eng.
data_description.subtitle_convert_vtt: Downloads, converts and serves WebVTT from Home Assistant.
data_description.subtitle_base_url: Recommended LAN URL reachable by Chromecast: {recommended_subtitle_base_url}
data_description.cast_compatibility_filter: Kept only to read older config entries. Format filtering is disabled because every source is transcoded.
data_description.stop_before_play: Stops the current reader before starting a new encoded stream.
data_description.cast_reset_before_play: For Cast entities, closes the receiver app before starting a clean session. It does not power off the TV.
data_description.fallback_enabled: Tries the next ranked source when Stream Server cannot create or play its encoded HLS output.
data_description.fallback_source_count: Sources are ordered by resolution, seed count and size, never by codec or container.
data_description.playback_start_timeout: HLS startup includes torrent buffering and encoder startup, so the default is longer than direct playback.
data_description.failure_notify_ha: Creates a persistent notification after every encoded candidate fails.
data_description.tvoverlay_enabled: Also sends the final failure to TvOverlay when configured.
data_description.tvoverlay_target: Optional target understood by the selected TvOverlay service.
data_description.tvoverlay_duration: How many seconds the failure overlay remains visible.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the main Stream Server. Check its IP address and port 11470.
error.invalid_config: The core configuration is invalid. Check the catalog and default stream URLs.
